key_line.detail: Thesis was $89-91M from 1,091k members x flat revenue per member against an $85.8M bar; actual $91.3M, top of that range. Members 1.1M (+36% y/y), non-GAAP gross margin 78% vs 68%.

guidance.detail: FY26 revenue $344-346M (was $334-340M); adj. EBITDA $32-34M (was $21-27M). Implied Q4 revenue ~$88M (my arithmetic), a sequential dip from $91.3M; no 2027 view in the release.

call.detail: Call held last night; no transcript or call summary was read in the time available. The after-hours and pre-market fall against a clean beat-and-raise suggests something on the call (2027 outlook, GLP-1 coverage, implied Q4 sequential dip) weighed, but that is inference, not sourced.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions or post-print headlines found in one search; aggregator snippets only note OMDA has often sold off after beats (Q1 2026 -9.3% on an EPS beat, snippet_only).

tape_read.note: Reference median $16.85 = -11.1% vs prev close $18.95, against a release read of +9% and a 5.9% historical median move: the opposite sign, nearly 2x the typical move. After-hours was -13.2%; pre-market range $16.24-$17.70, so it has already bounced off the low. 31 prints, 3 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:10: alive but thin, not stale. Position (entry $18.52) is -9.0%.

thesis_check.note: The release confirms the thesis line exactly (revenue at the top of the member-count range, guide raised), but the market rejected it overnight for a reason not visible in the release, most likely call commentary.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market traded through the night and is not stale, so the open should hold most of the -11% gap. A gap nearly twice the typical move, on a release that reads cleanly positive and already bouncing off its $16.24 low, tends to give some back in the first half hour; an unknown negative from the call keeps confidence low.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren duidelijk beter dan verwacht en de jaarprognose ging omhoog, maar het aandeel staat voorbeurs ruim 11% lager, bijna twee keer de gebruikelijke beweging. Een positie die zo hard tegen de cijfers in verliest, krijgt in het eerste half uur vaak een deel terug; daarom niet op de opening verkopen maar om 10:00.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als vóór 09:30 een duidelijke negatieve reden uit de call bekend wordt (bijvoorbeeld een zwakke vooruitblik op 2027) of de voorbeurskoers onder $16,24 zakt, dan toch op de opening verkopen.
